{
  "prompt_shell": {
    "version": "3.5-MZLO-LIC-v1.0",
    "name": "LIC 4.0 - LinkedIn Outreach Canonical (v2025-09-23)",
    "purpose": "Define authority, scope, enforceable rules, and non-negotiables for converting any prompt into the canonical six-section structure.",
    "sections_required": [
      "1.role",
      "2.task",
      "3.context",
      "4.reasoning",
      "5.output",
      "6.conditions"
    ],
    "enforcement": {
      "reject_out_of_order_emission": true,
      "block_output_on_reasoning_qa_fail": true,
      "block_output_on_mzlo_fail": true,
      "enforce_decimal_numbering": true,
      "enforce_subsection_alignment": true,
      "forbid_unstructured_appendices": true,
      "strict_ascii_hygiene": true,
      "all_fields_present_block": true,
      "block_on_mzlo_fail": true
    },
    "constraints": {
      "thresholds_audit": {
        "avg_exec_score_min": 0.9,
        "avg_s_score_min": 0.9,
        "avg_answer_score_min": 0.9,
        "max_retries_reasoning_rewrites": 2
      },
      "retrieval_quality": {
        "coverage_min": 0.85,
        "relevance_min": 0.9,
        "coherence_min": 0.9,
        "utilization_max": 0.8,
        "precision_min": 0.9,
        "recall_min": 0.85,
        "rerank_required": true,
        "hyde_required": true
      }
    },
    "required_fields_by_section": {
      "1.role": [
        "purpose",
        "standards",
        "canonical_boundary",
        "customization_markers",
        "minimal_runtime_inputs"
      ],
      "2.task": [
        "purpose",
        "deliverable_target",
        "success_criteria",
        "core_task",
        "advanced_practices"
      ],
      "3.context": [
        "purpose",
        "runtime_toggles",
        "dynamic_context_assembly",
        "agentic_retrieval_workflow",
        "ambiguity_resolution",
        "cross_check_self_test"
      ],
      "4.reasoning": [
        "phase_1_agentic_retrieval",
        "phase_2_transparency_notes",
        "policy_guardrails",
        "phase_3_hybrid_execution",
        "phase_4_reflexion",
        "phase_5_qa_precheck",
        "phase_6_validation_metrics"
      ],
      "5.output": [
        "purpose",
        "detected_settings_summary_template",
        "final_answer",
        "post_key_mandatory_subsections",
        "style_standalone_conformance",
        "mzlo_compliance_statement"
      ],
      "6.conditions": [
        "purpose",
        "immediate_execution",
        "schema_enforcement",
        "mzlo_compliance",
        "toggle_guard",
        "privacy_memory",
        "external_evidence",
        "computational_accuracy",
        "socratic_ambiguity",
        "transformer_metrics",
        "reasoning_mode_precedence",
        "audit_ready_assurance",
        "numbering_alignment_enforcement"
      ]
    },
    "1.role": {
      "purpose": {
        "text": "Define authority, scope, and non-negotiables for converting any prompt into the canonical six-section structure.",
        "canonical_sections": [
          "Role",
          "Task",
          "Context",
          "Reasoning",
          "Output(+QA)",
          "Conditions"
        ]
      },
      "standards": {
        "reasoning_isolation": {
          "methods_allowed": [
            "CoT",
            "ToT",
            "Self-Consistency",
            "Reflexion",
            "Decomposition",
            "Socratic",
            "Scratchpad"
          ],
          "confined_to_section": 4,
          "enforced": true
        },
        "runtime_toggle_transparency": {
          "surface_in_section": 3,
          "explicit_user_confirmation_required": true
        },
        "ambiguity_granularity": {
          "multi_topic_expand_numerically": true,
          "detection": "Identify insufficiencies and ambiguities.",
          "documentation": "Record gaps and impacts.",
          "resolution": "Apply Socratic prompts, annotations, granularity boosts before execution."
        },
        "strict_mzlo": {
          "requirements": [
            "zero_loss",
            "zero_ambiguity",
            "zero_misrepresentation",
            "zero_omission"
          ],
          "record_conformance": true,
          "forbid_mzlo_table_embedding_here": true
        },
        "audit_ready_qa": {
          "enforce": [
            "QA_Tables",
            "Schema_Enforcement",
            "Reflexion_or_Self-Consistency"
          ],
          "end_to_end": true
        },
        "structured_retrieval_and_context_engineering": {
          "apply": [
            "hybrid_retrieval",
            "chunking",
            "deduplication",
            "adaptive_assembly"
          ],
          "best_practices": true
        }
      },
      "canonical_boundary": {
        "forbid_beyond_sections_1_to_6": true
      },
      "customization_markers": {
        "CUSTOM": "requires project- or run-specific input",
        "OPTIONAL": "may be customized; defaults are acceptable",
        "GENERIC": "keep as-is across all prompts",
        "TEMPLATE": "fill the provided table or fields",
        "CHOICE": "select from allowed values"
      },
      "minimal_runtime_inputs": {
        "required": [
          "DOMAIN_SUBSECTIONS_TEMPLATE (keys K.1..K.m)",
          "Table_3A.toggle_states.current",
          "MZLO_ARTIFACT_ID",
          "Table_3D.pinned_versions",
          "Role_Catalog_ID_or_policy_if_role_mapping"
        ]
      }
    },
    "2.task": {
      "purpose": "State the conversion objective and rigor constraints for restructuring any prompt into Sections 1\u20136.",
      "deliverable_target": {
        "rules": [
          "Produce the complete artifact using six sections only with full overwrite and no dependency on prior versions.",
          "Follow OUTPUT spec precisely (strict JSON where required; plain text where specified).",
          "CoT/ToT appear only in Reasoning (audit-only).",
          "No audit artifacts appear in OUTPUT.",
          "Rigor parity is mandatory where applicable; block OUTPUT on FAIL.",
          "If AUDIT_VISIBILITY=true, Reasoning includes Trace Manifest A\u2013K (compact, pointer-based)."
        ]
      },
      "success_criteria": {
        "output_gate": [
          "schemas_valid",
          "catalog_rules_satisfied",
          "canonical_rules_satisfied",
          "hygiene_clean"
        ],
        "reasoning_gate": [
          "audit_only_separation",
          "maxtrace_pointer_present",
          "retries_lte_2"
        ],
        "audit_thresholds": {
          "avg_exec_score_min": 0.9,
          "avg_s_score_min": 0.9,
          "avg_answer_score_min": 0.9
        },
        "trace_manifest_required_when_audit_visibility_true": true,
        "no_audit_leakage_in_output": true
      },
      "core_task": {
        "restructure_into_six_section_shell": true,
        "preserve_critical_details_and_intent_mzlo_zero_loss": true
      },
      "advanced_practices": {
        "hybrid_cot_tot_in_section_4": {
          "mandatory": true,
          "retrieval_defaults": {
            "mode": "hybrid+rerank",
            "k": 8,
            "second_pass": "on_demand"
          },
          "agentic_branches_when_coverage_below_tau": [
            "no_new",
            "rewrite_rerank",
            "hyde"
          ]
        },
        "context_management_pipeline": {
          "mini_dag_order": [
            "Filter",
            "Dedup",
            "Rerank",
            "Compress",
            "Label",
            "Order",
            "Insert"
          ],
          "rerank": {
            "cross_encoder_over": [
              "BM25",
              "dense"
            ]
          },
          "compress_preserve": [
            "citations",
            "IDs"
          ],
          "pin_critical_edges": true,
          "reenter_at_step_3_when_coverage_below_tau": true,
          "settings": {
            "k": 8,
            "rerank_k": 20,
            "hybrid": true,
            "cross_encoder": true,
            "hyde_on_demand": true
          }
        },
        "toggle_gating": {
          "echo_and_lock_toggles": [
            "SHOW_REASONING",
            "COT_AUDIT",
            "TOT_AUDIT",
            "TRACE_TRANSFORMER",
            "HYBRID_MODE",
            "Retrieval/Memory/Advanced params",
            "Budget/Overlay/AuditView",
            "ContextBudget/Health",
            "Retriever",
            "AgenticRetrieval",
            "ContextPlanner",
            "Router",
            "ET_Anchor"
          ],
          "fail_fast_alerts": [
            "missing_toggles",
            "router_off",
            "missing_et_anchor",
            "overlay_leakage",
            "missing_trace_manifest_when_audit_visibility_true"
          ]
        },
        "reasoning_isolation": {
          "audit_artifacts_live_in_reasoning_only": true,
          "trace_manifest_A_to_K": [
            "detected_settings",
            "cot_tot_summaries",
            "path_metrics",
            "self_consistency",
            "reflexion_notes",
            "tool_plan",
            "overlay_snapshot",
            "token_ledger",
            "maxtrace",
            "evidence_pack"
          ],
          "never_emit_in_output": true
        },
        "three_layer_qa": {
          "universal_gate_schema": {
            "columns": [
              "Gate Check",
              "Verification Criteria",
              "Enforcement Layers",
              "Evidence Pointer(s)",
              "Result (PASS/FAIL)",
              "Remediation Note*"
            ],
            "rows_must_cover": [
              "Detected Settings Accuracy",
              "Agentic Retrieval Completeness",
              "Explicit Gap Resolution",
              "Evidence & Traceability Mapping",
              "Source Attribution Compliance",
              "Hybrid CoT->ToT Execution",
              "ToT Path Metrics Logging",
              "NOTES & ANSWER Separation",
              "Arithmetic Accuracy",
              "Non-deferral Assurance",
              "Context & Memory Utilization",
              "Transformer Metrics Logging",
              "Six-Section Enforcement",
              "Numbering & Alignment",
              "Privacy & Sensitive-Data Compliance",
              "Omission Audit",
              "Style & Standalone Conformance",
              "Domain-Specific Gates (optional)"
            ]
          },
          "schema_validation": {
            "enforce_run_order": [
              "Role",
              "Task",
              "Context",
              "Reasoning",
              "Output",
              "Conditions"
            ],
            "allow_pauses_only_after_section_5_subsections": true,
            "on_fatal_blocker_emit_conditions_alert_and_stop": true
          },
          "reflexion_or_self_consistency": {
            "max_mini_cots": 5,
            "re_emit_until_all_pass": true,
            "tie_breakers_if_within_0.02": "deterministic; document in Trace Manifest"
          }
        },
        "curated_retrieval_and_assembly": {
          "thresholds": {
            "coverage_min": 0.85,
            "relevance_min": 0.9,
            "coherence_min": 0.9,
            "utilization_max": 0.8
          },
          "pin_critical_constraints": true,
          "truncation_logging_audit_only": true,
          "branch_and_retry_if_under_tau": true
        }
      }
    },
    "3.context": {
      "purpose": "Declare the runtime controls and assembly plan that govern reasoning and output.",
      "runtime_toggles": {
        "table_3A": [
          {
            "group": "Visibility",
            "toggle": "SHOW_REASONING",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Controls whether reasoning traces are displayed.",
            "what_it_means": "If ON, exposes Section 4 reasoning notes and ToT path metrics.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "May overwhelm user with audit details or leak internal logic."
          },
          {
            "group": "Visibility",
            "toggle": "SCRATCHPAD_MODE",
            "default": "notes_vs_answer",
            "current": "notes_vs_answer",
            "description": "Configures scratchpad visibility in outputs.",
            "what_it_means": "Separates internal reasoning notes from final output.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Overly verbose notes may bloat context and slow output."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "COT",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Enable stepwise chain-of-thought reasoning.",
            "what_it_means": "Requires linear, explicit step-by-step logic in reasoning.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "May produce over-detailed or slow outputs if steps are excessive."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "TOT",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Enable tree-of-thought (branching) reasoning.",
            "what_it_means": "Explores multiple candidate reasoning branches before selecting a path.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "May cause token explosion or decision sprawl if branches are excessive."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "TOT_BRANCHING_FACTOR_B",
            "default": "3",
            "current": "3",
            "description": "Branching factor: number of alternatives per ToT step.",
            "what_it_means": "How many branches are explored at each ToT expansion.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "High B can lead to sprawl, excessive compute, slow decisions."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "TOT_DEPTH_D",
            "default": "2",
            "current": "2",
            "description": "Depth of ToT exploration.",
            "what_it_means": "Number of expansion layers before branches are pruned and selected.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "High D increases context size and risk of runaway reasoning."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "HYBRID_COT_TOT",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Force hybrid reasoning (CoT then ToT where needed).",
            "what_it_means": "Combines stepwise and branching approaches for robustness.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Hybridized sprawl can be slow and hard to debug if not bounded."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "SELF_CONSISTENCY",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Enable self-consistency voting.",
            "what_it_means": "Multiple independent runs compared for consensus.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Too many runs increase cost and delay with diminishing returns."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "SC_K",
            "default": "5",
            "current": "5",
            "description": "Number of self-consistency runs.",
            "what_it_means": "How many full reasoning chains to run and vote.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Excessive K is slow and token-hungry."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "SOCRATIC",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Enable Socratic clarifying Q&A before reasoning.",
            "what_it_means": "Prompts model to clarify or resolve ambiguity before proceeding.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Too many Q&A rounds can stall progress."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "REFLEXION",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Enable self-critique and revision loops.",
            "what_it_means": "Performs critique \u2192 refine cycles for higher answer quality.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Too many loops can cause over-editing and latency."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "DECOMPOSITION",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Enable explicit decomposition of complex tasks.",
            "what_it_means": "Splits big problems into smaller independently reasoned pieces.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Over-fragmentation inflates reasoning and context cost."
          },
          {
            "group": "Methods",
            "toggle": "SCRATCHPAD",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Separate scratchpad notes from final answer.",
            "what_it_means": "Ensures audit trail and output clarity.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Excess scratchpad can clutter logs and obscure final outputs."
          },
          {
            "group": "RAG",
            "toggle": "RAG_MODE",
            "default": "ON",
            "current": "ON",
            "description": "Enable retrieval-augmented generation pipeline.",
            "what_it_means": "Combines retrieved knowledge with generative answer.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Over-grounding may block creative or nuanced reasoning."
          },
          {
            "group": "RAG",
            "toggle": "RAG_STRATEGY",
            "default": "hybrid",
            "current": "hybrid",
            "description": "Retrieval strategy: keyword/semantic/hybrid.",
            "what_it_means": "Controls mix of keyword, semantic or both in retrieval.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Complex hybrid may retrieve too much, slowing model."
          },
          {
            "group": "RAG",
            "toggle": "RAG_MIN_DOCS",
            "default": "2",
            "current": "2",
            "description": "Minimum # docs/snippets for grounding.",
            "what_it_means": "Forces model to consult at least this many docs.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "High minimum may pollute answer with marginal content."
          },
          {
            "group": "RAG",
            "toggle": "RAG_MAX_DOCS",
            "default": "8",
            "current": "8",
            "description": "Maximum # docs/snippets for grounding.",
            "what_it_means": "Caps number of sources pulled in.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Excessive max causes context overload and slower inference."
          },
          {
            "group": "Retrieval",
            "toggle": "AGENTIC_MODE",
            "default": "ON",
            "current": "ON",
            "description": "Enable agentic multi-hop retrieval.",
            "what_it_means": "Allows model to perform multiple query hops.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Can waste cycles if hops are unbounded."
          },
          {
            "group": "Retrieval",
            "toggle": "AGENTIC_MAX_HOPS",
            "default": "2",
            "current": "2",
            "description": "Maximum retrieval hops allowed.",
            "what_it_means": "Limits multi-hop search depth.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "High limit can chase irrelevant tangents."
          },
          {
            "group": "Retrieval",
            "toggle": "RETRIEVAL_SOURCES",
            "default": "hybrid",
            "current": "hybrid",
            "description": "Which sources to retrieve from.",
            "what_it_means": "Hybrid = both keyword and semantic sources.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Too broad may bring irrelevant context; too narrow may miss data."
          },
          {
            "group": "Retrieval",
            "toggle": "RETRIEVAL_COUNT",
            "default": "3",
            "current": "3",
            "description": "How many results returned per retrieval.",
            "what_it_means": "Balances recall and signal-to-noise ratio.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Too high = noise; too low = missed facts."
          },
          {
            "group": "Retrieval",
            "toggle": "QUERY_REFINEMENT",
            "default": "ON",
            "current": "ON",
            "description": "Allow query rephrasing/refinement.",
            "what_it_means": "Retries retrieval on missed context.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "May loop or add latency if unconstrained."
          },
          {
            "group": "Retrieval",
            "toggle": "SOURCE_ATTRIBUTION",
            "default": "ON",
            "current": "ON",
            "description": "Enforce evidence/source mapping.",
            "what_it_means": "Every output claim must map to a source.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Too verbose attributions can bloat final answer."
          },
          {
            "group": "Retrieval",
            "toggle": "RETRIEVAL_QUALITY_THRESHOLD",
            "default": "policy",
            "current": "policy",
            "description": "Enforce retrieval quality (precision/recall).",
            "what_it_means": "Sets precision\u22650.90, recall\u22650.85 as minimum.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Too strict = useful sources missed; too loose = noise."
          },
          {
            "group": "Metrics",
            "toggle": "TRACE_TRANSFORMER",
            "default": "off",
            "current": "on",
            "description": "Log transformer attention/metrics.",
            "what_it_means": "Allows debugging and transparency.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "May expose internals or impact performance."
          },
          {
            "group": "Metrics",
            "toggle": "METRICS_OVERLAY",
            "default": "transformer_v1",
            "current": "transformer_v1",
            "description": "Overlay reasoning metrics.",
            "what_it_means": "Adds model stability and error signal to run log.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Too much telemetry clutters logs."
          },
          {
            "group": "Metrics",
            "toggle": "METRICS_TIER",
            "default": "1",
            "current": "1",
            "description": "How deep to log metrics.",
            "what_it_means": "1=basic; 2=full attention/gradient log.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Tier 2+ slows system and increases data volume."
          },
          {
            "group": "Metrics",
            "toggle": "METRICS_SAMPLING",
            "default": "on_suspect",
            "current": "on_suspect",
            "description": "Metrics sampling policy.",
            "what_it_means": "When to record diagnostic telemetry.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Sample too often = heavy cost; too rarely = miss bugs."
          },
          {
            "group": "MZLO",
            "toggle": "BLOCK_OUTPUT_ON_MZLO_FAIL",
            "default": "true",
            "current": "true",
            "description": "Block outputs if zero-loss not proven.",
            "what_it_means": "No final output unless audit passes all MZLO criteria.",
            "risk_if_too_high": "Overblocking can halt production if policy is misconfigured."
          }
        ],
        "LEARNING_MODE": {
          "default": "true",
          "description": "If true, emit all reasoning, QA, and layman blocks for every K.x in Section 4. No omissions, no collapses."
        },
        "table_3A_enforcement": {
          "required": true,
          "required_fields": [
            "group",
            "toggle",
            "default",
            "current",
            "prompt_section",
            "configures",
            "impact",
            "risk_if_too_high"
          ],
          "block_on_missing": true,
          "block_on_null_or_empty": true,
          "smoke_test": {
            "name": "table_3A_full_render",
            "assertions": [
              "len(table_3A) >= 1",
              "all_fields_present(required_fields)",
              "no_truncation_in_output"
            ],
            "block_on_fail": true
          }
        }
      },
      "dynamic_context_assembly": {
        "table_3B": [
          {
            "order": 1,
            "layer": "cinstr",
            "contents": "Sections 1\u20132 constraints."
          },
          {
            "order": 2,
            "layer": "cquery",
            "contents": "User request canonized."
          },
          {
            "order": 3,
            "layer": "cmem",
            "contents": "Relevant memory slices."
          },
          {
            "order": 4,
            "layer": "cknow",
            "contents": "External knowledge via hybrid retrieval."
          },
          {
            "order": 5,
            "layer": "cretrieval_plan",
            "contents": "Multi-hop log (queries, tools, rationales, gaps)."
          },
          {
            "order": 6,
            "layer": "ctools",
            "contents": "Available tools inventory."
          },
          {
            "order": 7,
            "layer": "cstate",
            "contents": "Time and status."
          }
        ],
        "per_key_insertion_order": "K.1..K.m"
      },
      "agentic_retrieval_workflow": {
        "table_3C": [
          {
            "step": 1,
            "action": "Formulate initial queries from cquery.",
            "quality_or_logging": "Record in cretrieval_plan."
          },
          {
            "step": 2,
            "action": "Hybrid retrieval: BM25 \u222a dense -> cross-encoder; HyDE if Coverage < tau.",
            "quality_or_logging": "Enforce precision>=0.90, recall>=0.85."
          },
          {
            "step": 3,
            "action": "Log queries, sources, rationales, outcomes.",
            "quality_or_logging": "Full hop log."
          },
          {
            "step": 4,
            "action": "Gap analysis; refine queries (QUERY_REFINEMENT=ON).",
            "quality_or_logging": "Note residual gaps."
          },
          {
            "step": 5,
            "action": "Iterate \u2264 AGENTIC_MAX_HOPS; log each hop.",
            "quality_or_logging": "Stop at cap."
          },
          {
            "step": 6,
            "action": "Deduplicate, compress, attribute; exclude irrelevant or sensitive items.",
            "quality_or_logging": "Attribute sources; prep for \u00a74."
          }
        ],
        "per_key_retrieval_logs": true
      },
      "ambiguity_resolution": "Use structured Socratic questioning; record resolutions for use in \u00a74.",
      "cross_check_self_test": "Emit toggle states in \u00a75.2 Detected Settings Summary.",
      "version_pins_optional": {
        "table_3D": [
          {
            "component": "Prompt Shell",
            "version": "v3.0"
          },
          {
            "component": "App Schema",
            "version": "v4 or project schema"
          },
          {
            "component": "App Tracker QA",
